visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 3x2 grid showing six different images of a young woman's face from the chest up. Each frame has a different anime eye graphic overlaid on her eyes. The background is a plain white wall. (2) A sharp cut leads to an exterior shot of a modern gray building with a glass door and signage reading '鼎妍中醫'. The camera pans slightly. (3) The scene shifts indoors to a stylish lobby with a dark patterned screen, a red human-like sculpture, and a green plant. The lighting is bright and modern. (4) The camera focuses on a massage bed covered with a Gucci-branded brown patterned blanket and a smaller brown fuzzy heating pad. (5) A close-up shows the woman lying down as hands in white sleeves use white cotton pads to clean her face. (6) The woman lies still with dozens of thin green and blue acupuncture needles inserted into her jawline, cheeks, and forehead. A red LED light therapy machine is positioned over her head. The doctor's hands are seen adjusting needles near her hair. (7) The woman is shown with a white sheet mask on her face while still under the red light. (8) The final sequence shows her face being massaged with cream, appearing clear and hydrated. (9) The video ends with a static screen recording of an Instagram profile page for 'dingyan6688'.
